title: Weather Systems
subtitle: Immovable Giants · Album
excerpt: A patient, heavy, weather-shaped record from the label's slowest-burning band.
body: Weather Systems is the new album from Immovable Giants — tectonic riffs, wide dynamics, and songs that take the long way around. Replace the copy, credits, and artwork path in data/latest/album.json with the official release. Play it from the QFR player the moment the masters are in.
